entries.wording: Virtual Manifest has been received by carrier
entries.note: The sender's manifest reached ECMS before the parcel; the tracker API sends it as EVENT_101 or EVENT_104.
Wording of the newer oms page for the manifest, before the parcel reaches ECMS.
Seen in the tracker API reply.

entries.wording: Documents and information required for clearance have been received by the carrier.
entries.note: The consignee supplied the clearance documents; the consignee page appends a line about shipping within days of receiving the parcel and ID.

entries.wording: ID information has been reviewed and verified
entries.note: The consignee's ID for import clearance was checked, before the parcel reached ECMS.
First scan at ECMS's origin warehouse.
Wording of the newer oms page for the same scan.

entries.wording: Parcel has arrived at export distribution warehouse
entries.note: ECMS's export warehouse at the origin, the same day as its arrival scan there; seen relayed by ePost Global.
Wording of the newer oms page.
The airport terminal's notice that the flight's cargo arrived, after the landing and before ECMS's transit warehouse.

entries.wording: Shipment has arrived at ECMS transit warehouse
entries.note: ECMS's warehouse at the arrival airport, before the import clearance.

entries.wording: Shipment has departed from ECMS transit warehouse
entries.note: After the import clearance, on the way to the destination facility.
Import clearance finished; the parcel moves on.

entries.wording: Parcel at destination facility, ready for next step
entries.note: Scanned after import clearance at the destination facility, before the hand-over to the last-mile carrier.

entries.wording: Parcel in transit during last mile delivery
entries.note: SpeedX's scan as ECMS relays it, after the destination facility and before the delivery round. It can repeat on later days.
Weighing scan at the destination facility.

entries.wording: Shipment is tendering to third party carrier for final delivery.
entries.note: Hand-over to the last-mile carrier, whose own number may then appear.

entries.wording: Local carrier has accepted package for final delivery

entries.note: Seen at the destination facility before the local carrier accepted the parcel the next day and delivery went on, so a problem rather than a return under way.

entries.wording: Shipment is in Transit within the carrier‘s network
entries.note: Last-mile carrier movement relayed by ECMS; the apostrophe is a left single quotation mark.
The local carrier holds the parcel for the recipient to collect.

entries.wording: 发货预报已收到，正在等待货物到达我们的始发站仓库
entries.note: Chinese text of the manifest event; Amazon shipments prefix it with the seller name Amazon.
Chinese text of the cleared event.

entries.wording: 货物已到达目的站仓库

entries.note: Chinese text of the flight departure event.
Chinese text of the flight arrival event.

entries.wording: 货物出库前往配送中心安排最终派送
entries.note: Chinese text of the hand-over to the last-mile carrier.
